job_title: Product Manager of AI Applications, Global Public Sector
description:
Scale is growing rapidly, and joining the Global Public Sector team is an opportunity to work on one of the most exciting and quickly expanding teams at Scale. This team is responsible for generating, executing, and fostering Scale’s work with governments and government-backed entities outside of the United States.

We develop bespoke solutions that leverage our customers’ proprietary data and expertise to transform their organizations with AI. We work with them to understand their pain points and workflows and then forward deploy our team to build cutting-edge solutions. The applications we build are powered by the Scale GenAI Platform, a full stack product to build, test and deploy frontier AI systems.

* Developing custom AI applications
* Building custom LLMs
* Providing high-quality training data for research and government institutions building LLMs
* Developing partnerships to foster regional talent growth and AI adoption

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced product leader to play a pivotal role in the ideation and development of transformative AI solutions. The ideal candidate has deep experience with AI/ML application development, can think strategically about how to solve a problem, is an excellent listener, is comfortable getting into the weeds operationally, and has a strong understanding of software engineering principles and practices. You will be responsible for owning large AI projects for one or many customers.

You will lead a cross-functional team of engineers, MLEs, and operators to build a highly impactful solution for our customers that will drive millions in revenue for our business as well.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead design workshops with the client to define custom AI solutions
* Scope out new AI application use cases across various government entities
* Lead cross-functional development of AI applications and custom LLMs with diverse stakeholders (Engineering + Ops + Go-to-Market)
* Consistently engage with future end-users to solicit feedback and ensure we are prioritizing effectively
* Stay up to date with latest research in applied AI and training custom LLMs
* Scope out model evaluation sets and performance requirements, consistently review results, and iterate on the solution
* Give regular progress updates to the client and International Public Sector leadership

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Deep curiosity and excitement about building AI applications that drive quantifiable impact.
* Mission-driven mindset with a strong desire to learn and grow quickly.

**Nice to haves:**

* Coding experience (Python)
* Proficiency in Arabic, both written and spoken
* 4+ years of experience building products with specific experience within the last 1-2 years building AI-powered products
* Strong technical background (STEM degree) and/or experience building technical software products
* Strong understanding of generative AI technologies and their applications in both enterprise and consumer settings
* Experience with vibe coding tools (i.e., Replit, Lovable, Bolt, etc.) and design tools (i.e., Figma, Canva, Miro, etc.)
* Exceptional leadership, presentation and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams

***PLEASE NOTE:*** *Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.*

**About Us:**

*At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta,* *Ernst* *&* *Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.*

*We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status.*

*We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's* [*Know Your Rights poster*](https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf) *for additional information.*

*We comply with the United States Department of Labor's* *Pay Transparency provision**.*

***PLEASE NOTE:** We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our [privacy policy](https://scale.com/legal/privacy) for additional information.*

## Company Description

Jobs for Humanity is collaborating with Takamol Holding to build an inclusive and just employment ecosystem. We support individuals coming from all walks of life.  
  
Company Name: Takamol Holding  
  

## Job Description

The Business Analyst Venture Building role is a strategic catalyst for turning market signals into validated growth opportunities. You will work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to identify compelling ventures, shape viable business cases, and steward concepts from idea to learning driven validation. This position blends analytical rigor with entrepreneurial energy to drive outcomes that matter for customers and the business alike. You will conduct rigorous market analysis to size opportunities, map customer needs, and understand competitive dynamics. You will translate market intelligence into actionable opportunities and craft business cases that articulate the value proposition, revenue model, pricing strategy, channel approach, cost structure, and financial projections including unit economics and ROI. Your insights will inform prioritization and guide the strategic roadmap for new ventures within the organization. Rapid prototyping and experimentation are at the core of your approach. You will define learning agendas with clear hypotheses, success criteria, and test plans, and you will partner with design and engineering to rapid prototype MVPs, pilots, or low fidelity experiments that produce measurable data. You will evaluate results, iterate quickly, and decide on next steps in collaboration with stakeholders, ensuring that every venture concept moves through a disciplined validation cycle while maintaining speed and momentum. Cross functional collaboration is essential. You will facilitate alignment across product management, design, engineering, data, and operations, translating market signals into product concepts and helping translate insights into concrete roadmaps. You will create compelling, decision ready materials for leadership and stakeholders, contribute to go to market planning, and ensure agreed delivery milestones across disciplines. Your influence will help teams work together efficiently toward a shared venture objective. As a contributor to the venture building practice, your responsibilities will include managing the lifecycle of venture concepts from discovery through validation, maintaining a hypothesis library, and tracking the metrics that define success. You will advocate for customer centric decisions, present findings to executives, and support scalable operating models that can be extended to future ventures. What you will bring includes a bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field and 4 to 7 years of experience in business analysis, strategy, product analytics, corporate development, or management consulting. You have experience in venture building or new product development and a track record of translating data into compelling business cases. You are proficient with market sizing, scenario planning, and financial modeling and comfortable using tools such as Excel or Sheets, SQL, or data visualization platforms. You communicate clearly and persuasively, can influence without authority, and thrive in fast paced environments with ambiguity. You are a collaborative teammate who enjoys working with product, design, and engineering to turn insights into impact. We offer a dynamic and inclusive culture that values curiosity, experimentation, and data driven decision making. You will join a high energy cross functional team and have opportunities to grow into product leadership or venture founder tracks, with exposure to multiple markets and business models. We provide competitive compensation, equity options where applicable, comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangements, and a commitment to professional development through mentoring and ongoing learning. If you are excited to build and validate new ventures from first principles and to influence product strategy through rigorous analysis and rapid prototyping, we encourage you to apply. Please share your resume and a short note describing a market opportunity you analyzed or a business case you developed and the impact it had. ## Responsibilities • Lead market research efforts to identify target customer segments, competitive dynamics, and total addressable market, delivering actionable insights within two weeks of project kickoff. • Build business cases and financial models (revenue, costs, cash flows, and ROI) to evaluate venture viability and inform investment and prioritization decisions. • Support rapid prototyping by translating insights into MVP scope, defining success metrics, and guiding cross-functional teams to iterate quickly. • Collaborate with cross-functional squads (product, engineering, design, data, marketing, and operations) to align on problem framing, requirements, and milestones, ensuring synchronized delivery. • Track performance metrics across ventures by establishing dashboards, defining KPIs, and providing regular performance updates to leadership and squads. • Conduct risk analysis and scenario planning to identify critical assumptions, quantify potential impacts, and develop mitigation strategies. • Evaluate strategic partnerships and business development opportunities by performing due diligence, modeling value creation, and outlining partnership terms and risks. • Translate strategic hypotheses into testable experiments, oversee experiment design, and measure outcomes to inform prioritization and roadmap adjustments.

job_title: Hijazi Dialect Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
Are you a Hijazi language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for Hijazi speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Hijazi language specialists who live and breathe Hijazi grammar, syntax, morphology, phonology, semantics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, case system (nominative, accusative, dative, genitive), word order, declensions, gender, and stylistic variation—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A bachelor's degree in Hijazi language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal, but we also highly value native-level fluency and a deep, practical understanding of the language's nuances. Extensive experience in teaching, translation, or community-based linguistic projects can substitute for a formal degree. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Hijazi language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Employment type: Freelance / Contract

Workplace type: Remote

Seniority level: Entry Level

description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Deployment Strategist at Wonderful, you are responsible for making AI deployments actually land.

Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today. You lead enterprise customers from early discovery through pilot and production rollout, translating ambitious AI initiatives into clear scopes, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. You sit between the customer, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product, ensuring everyone is aligned on what is being built, why it matters, and how it will succeed in production.

This is a hands-on role for people who enjoy ambiguity, ownership, and seeing complex projects through to the end.

- Embed deeply with customers to understand their processes and systems, identify the most important problems to solve, and obsess over helping them win.

- Lead discovery with enterprise customers to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria.

- Define scope, success metrics, and integration plans for pilots and rollouts.

- Translate customer needs into clear deployment plans for engineering teams.

- Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders.

- Track progress, manage risks, and remove blockers throughout the deployment.

- Support production launches and ensure solutions are adopted and working as intended.

- Monitor deployed agents and drive follow-up improvements based on real usage.

- Identify additional use cases and expansion opportunities with customers.

You will spend time onsite with customers, working through real constraints, answering difficult questions, and ensuring solutions deliver real value.

WHY SHOULD YOU

- You’ll be part of what is tipped as the fastest-growing startup in Europe.

- Work on a cutting-edge agentic solution, the hottest topic in Enterprise right now.

- You’ll join a team of high-agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there.

- Never boring - you’ll be solving problems for and with the biggest Enterprises in the world.

WHO YOU ARE

- Experience in deployment-focused, technical, or execution-oriented roles.

- Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into concrete plans.

- Comfort working with technical concepts such as APIs, MCP, data flows, and system integrations.

- Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills.

- High ownership mindset and bias toward action.

- Interest in building and deploying AI-powered systems in real environments.

NICE TO HAVE

- Background in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or forward-deployed roles.

- Prior hands-on engineering experience.

- Experience supporting production software launches.

- Experience working in high-growth or early-stage environments.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Enterprises are ready to use AI, but execution is the hard part.
This role exists to bridge that gap. You will help customers deploy AI agents that integrate with real systems, respect real constraints, and deliver measurable outcomes.

**Job Title:** Graphic Designer

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Location:** Remote

**Role Overview**  
Our client is seeking a versatile, bilingual Graphic Designer who can shape brand identity and translate complex datasets into clear visual narratives. This isn’t a standard design role, you’ll be embedded in a tech-forward environment creating UI assets, pitch decks, social content, and infographics at pace.

Speed, flexibility, and precision are non-negotiable. You’ll toggle between English and Arabic layouts with fluency and understand both typographic traditions. Curiosity about AI and emerging tech is a major plus.

**What You’ll Own**

**Brand & Visual Identity**

* Maintain and evolve aiXplain’s brand across digital, print, and presentations
* Ensure visual consistency at speed without sacrificing quality
* Build brand guidelines and scalable templates

**Bilingual Design (Arabic & English)**

* Design seamless layouts for Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR)
* Master Arabic typography, spacing, and cultural visual nuance
* Handle both languages with equal mastery—no outsourcing or approximation

**Data Visualization**

* Turn complex AI/technical data into clear, compelling visual stories
* Design charts, infographics, dashboards, and reports that communicate instantly
* Collaborate with product and research teams on model outputs and metrics

**Tech-Oriented Creative**

* Create assets for AI products, developer-facing content, and technical marketing
* Work closely with engineers and PMs—speak their language
* Stay current with tech design trends: UI kits, developer docs, SaaS aesthetics, AI/ML branding

**Delivery & Flexibility**

* Deliver high-quality assets fast (tight deadlines are the norm)
* Adapt across formats: social, presentations, web graphics, motion stubs, print
* Manage multiple briefs without dropping quality or missing deadlines

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Haves**

* Bilingual fluency in Arabic & English (written + design)
* Professional typographic skills in both scripts
* Strong data visualization portfolio
* Proven brand design experience
* Tech industry exposure or genuine interest in AI/ML
* Fast turnaround track record
* Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)

**Strong Advantages**

* Experience designing for SaaS or AI products
* Motion graphics or basic animation skills
* Familiarity with developer tools or technical documentation
* Experience with design systems at scale
* Background in UX/UI design principles
* Prior work with bilingual marketing campaigns

**Role Details**

* Location: Remote
* Type: Full-time
* Languages Required: Arabic & English (bilingual design proficiency essential)
* Reports To: Comms
* Availability: Responsive to fast-turnaround requests across time zones

description:
As a Strategic Consultant, you are a key technical consultant/architect on AvePoint’s solutions and services engagements with our clients both remotely and on-site. This role will evaluate, manage and deliver on projects that accelerate customer adoption of their Microsoft investments.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Serving as the technical lead and consultant for the delivery of services engagements ranging from management, migration and protection of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint through the implementation of AvePoint tools and solutions

* Architecting, configuring, and deploying enterprise implementations for the AvePoint product line and the Microsoft technology stack, including next generation product stack

* Offer expert guidance on AvePoint and associated Cloud technologies.

* Delivering training sessions to customers through web-based conferences or onsite at customer’s location

* Implementing proposed technical strategies and solutions to satisfy customers’ business needs

* Acting as the customer advocate and liaison for product management and development

* Compiling technical documentation of projects and implementations as well as service deliverables

* Effectively and accurately setting client expectations and deliverables

* Playing the role of an the ground technical resource by providing technical support, product demonstration, and/or solution consultation

* Proposing and/or designing technical solutions, which include creating prototypes and proofs of concept to assist the product selection process

* Providing validation and readiness of AvePoint products against technical and business requirements

* Servicing various technical projects for internal purposes

* Advancing internal-QA and Scenario testing with virtualized infrastructures and technologies

Success Metrics include, but are not limited to the candidate’s ability to:

* Project and explain ROI

* Project and explain the Business Value delivered

* Project and explain the Rate of Change

* Drive Service Delivery Success

* Manage Stakeholder Engagement

* Drive Customer Experience

* Guarantee End User Satisfaction

* Monitor Technical Debt Index

* Balance speed, value and quality

**OK, I'm interested... is this the job for me?**

We look for people who value agility, passion and teamwork; those who can bring fresh ideas to the table and want the opportunity to learn, grow, and expand their careers. Bring your aptitude and build upon what you do best for our customers, partners, team, and you.

As a Strategic Consultant, you are someone who loves working as a consultant on software delivery projects with external customers. Ideal candidates should enterprise level expertise of SharePoint, Microsoft 365 and relevant services.

Other qualities you’ll need to be a fit for this role include:

* 6+ years of experience in architectural design and development with a focus on planning, deploying or supporting enterprise level Microsoft 365 and Azure applications

* Solid understanding of Microsoft 365, Azure, and SharePoint services architecture, components, and configuration differences for all versions

* Experience in managing and running projects such as digital transformation, change management, system migrations, consolidation, and deployment

* Experience with programming constructs, business logic development, information architecture, and taxonomy strategies supporting web services in a SharePoint/.NET environment

* Expert in leading workshops including IT governance and information governance & compliance strategy topics for enterprise level SharePoint implementations

* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, Active Directory, DNS, SMTP, and DHCP technologies

* Understanding of IT governance and compliance standards such as ITIL and COBIT

* Working technical knowledge of current software protocols and Internet standards

* Must be self-motivated with the ability to set and meet deadlines on multiple projects without frequent supervision

* Effective oral and written communication skills with exceptional customer service skills, including the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of customers

* Excellent technical writing skills and proven track record of composing guides, testing documents, technical outlines and schematics

* Arabic speaker

CoorB is all about digital finance. We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.  

ABOUT **CoorB**  

We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.  

   

OUR OPPORTUNITY  

The Technical Project Manager manages the full transformation program across current-state assessment, target-state design, migration, validation, deployment, decommissioning, and cost optimization.   

YOU WILL  

·        Manage the integrated project plan across architecture, BI, ETL, data modeling, governance, platform, and business workstreams.  
·        Coordinate current-state assessment and target-state implementation activities.  
·        Track migration waves, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and decisions.  
·        Coordinate stakeholders across business, IT, vendors, architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations.  
·        Manage coexistence risks between existing and target platforms.  
·        Track report migration, ETL migration, data reconciliation, UAT, deployment, and sign-off.  
·        Track licensing optimization and decommissioning milestones.  
·        Maintain RAID logs, status reports, steering committee updates, and delivery governance.  
·        Ensure legacy components are not left running unnecessarily after target-state migration.  
·        Support change management, communication, and business readiness.  

  

### Requirements

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THE ROLE YOU NEED  

·        Strong experience managing technical data, BI, DWH, or platform transformation programs.  
·        Understanding of data architecture, ETL, BI, governance, MDM, and cloud modernization concepts.  
·        Strong planning, dependency management, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.  
·        Experience with Agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery models.  
·        Experience with JIRA, MS Project, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar tools.  
·        Ability to communicate effectively with executives and technical teams.

description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a high-caliber **Senior System Analyst** to join our team in Riyadh. You will bridge business stakeholders, project leadership, architects, and delivery teams for a large-scale digital integration program. You will translate business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear functional and technical requirements across integration services, event streaming, the developer portal, reporting, and operations. You will also coordinate interface requirements with the AI engineering workstream, while AI model design, development, and training remain outside this role. The ideal candidate is a native Arabic speaker with excellent English fluency and strong command of the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirements Engineering:** Lead discovery with business and technical stakeholders to elicit, analyze, validate, and trace functional and non-functional requirements for the non-AI project scope.

**System Analysis & Documentation:** Produce BRDs, SRS, functional and technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, interface requirements, data mappings, and analysis documents for integration services and event topics.

**Process & Integration Modelling:** Document current- and future-state processes, gap analyses, workflows, sequence diagrams, system interactions, APIs, integration mappings, and data flows.

**Requirements Lifecycle & Governance:** Maintain traceability, backlog readiness, change requests, priorities, dependencies, and alignment with security, data, service-level, and technical governance requirements.

**Validation & Acceptance Support:** Define acceptance criteria and test scenarios; collaborate with QA on integration, performance, and UAT activities; and verify delivered services against approved requirements.

**Cross-Functional Delivery & AI Coordination:** Work with integration, portal, event-streaming, operations, cybersecurity, data-governance, and AI teams; define AI-related interfaces and data requirements without owning AI model design, development, or training; and support handover and knowledge transfer.

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

**Experience:** 5+ years of experience in Systems Analysis or Business Systems Analysis, including enterprise integration or digital transformation projects.

**Process & Tool Proficiency:**

Strong expertise in requirements engineering, stakeholder facilitation, functional and non-functional analysis, traceability, and change management.

Hands-on experience with requirements, backlog, and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and MS Visio (or similar).

Deep understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum delivery, including documentation, testing, UAT, and release-readiness activities.

**Data & Technical Skills:**

Strong working knowledge of APIs, web services, system interfaces, data mapping, integration patterns, and event-driven systems.

Practical knowledge of databases, SQL, JSON, XML, interface specifications, and secure system-integration concepts.

Preferred exposure to IBM App Connect, API Connect, DataPower, MQ, Kafka/Confluent, developer portals, Instana, or Kibana.

**Communication & Domain Knowledge:**

Native Arabic speaker with excellent English fluency (written and spoken).

Ability to explain complex system behaviour, dependencies, and technical requirements clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Familiarity with KSA digital transformation, cybersecurity, data-governance, and regulatory environments is a strong plus.

**Professional Attributes:**

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to evaluate complex requirements, identify gaps, and support viable system solutions.

Proven ability to work across business, architecture, development, QA, operations, security, data, and AI workstreams.

High attention to detail, clear ownership of requirements, and commitment to meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

description:
**Who Are We**

  
HALA is a leading fintech player in the MENAP region that aims to redefine financial services and build the future bank of SMEs. HALA aims at empowering SMEs to start, run, and grow their businesses by providing them with cutting-edge financial and technological tools.

  
HALA currently holds multiple entities in UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt (including HALA Payments and HALA Logistics) and offers solutions that enable merchants to digitize their payments as well as manage their sales and operations.

  
Founded in 2017, HALA is currently licensed by the Saudi Arabian Central Bank.

**Job Description :**

The Project Manager (PMO) is responsible for leading and executing complex business projects while ensuring strategic alignment and adherence to technical standards. This role requires strong technical expertise, leadership, and the ability to drive projects independently with minimal oversight.

**COLLECTIVE**

* Comply with the HALA’s code of conduct and ethics
* Promote the HALA’s vision, mission, values and model desired behaviors
* Promote HALA and spread its culture
* Commit to HALA’s rules and regulations
* Perform tasks as directed in the pursuit of the achievement of organizational goals
* Share with team know-how and encourage their development

**JOB-SPECIFIC**

* Lead and execute complex business projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and technical standards.
* Apply advanced business & technical knowledge to oversee integrations, server configurations, and cybersecurity measures for payment solutions.
* Mentor and guide project teams, setting clear expectations, and promoting a culture of excellence and accountability.
* Develop and refine project management frameworks, employing best practices tailored to the payments industry.
* Coordinating closely with the Head of Enterprise and demonstrating significant autonomy in decision-making.

**Job Purpose**

The Senior Presales Solutions Architect is responsible for leading the technical presales lifecycle for opportunities involving digital solutions, enterprise platforms, microservices, artificial intelligence, data, analytics, business intelligence and telecom solutions.

The role works closely with sales, delivery, product, architecture, finance, partners and customers to understand business needs, define suitable solution approaches, design robust technical architectures, prepare high-quality technical proposals, estimate implementation efforts and present proposed solutions to executive, business and technical stakeholders.

The position requires strong technical architecture capabilities, telecom industry knowledge, proposal development experience, commercial awareness, stakeholder management and customer presentation skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Opportunity Qualification and Presales Planning**

* Review customer opportunities, RFPs, RFIs, tenders, statements of work and business requirements.
* Assess opportunities from technical, delivery, resource, commercial and strategic perspectives.
* Participate in Go/No-Go evaluations and provide clear technical recommendations.
* Identify missing information, dependencies, risks, assumptions and clarification questions.
* Develop presales response plans, technical workstreams, responsibilities and submission timelines.
* Coordinate with sales, PMO, delivery, finance, legal, cybersecurity and external partners.
* Evaluate whether each opportunity is aligned with the organization’s capabilities, technologies, resources and strategic direction.
* Identify technical gaps and recommend suitable partners or subcontractors where required.

**2\. Requirements Analysis and Solution Definition**

* Conduct discovery sessions and workshops with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional and non-functional technical requirements.
* Understand customer challenges, existing platforms, integration landscapes, data sources, operational processes and future objectives.
* Define suitable use cases across digital solutions, microservices, AI, data, BI and telecom domains.
* Prioritize use cases based on value, feasibility, cost, implementation complexity and expected outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, intelligent services, analytics and customer experience enhancement.
* Ensure requirements are clear, measurable, traceable and aligned with the proposed solution.
* Prepare requirement-traceability and compliance matrices.
* Validate requirements with business, technical, security and operational stakeholders.

**3\. Digital Solution Architecture**

* Design end-to-end digital solution architectures covering enterprise portals, web applications, mobile applications, content management, workflows, integration, data, security, infrastructure and operations.
* Prepare high-level architecture, logical architecture, system-context diagrams, integration diagrams, deployment views and data-flow diagrams.
* Recommend suitable technologies, frameworks, platforms and architectural patterns.
* Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, observable and cost-effective.
* Design solutions for cloud, on-premises, hybrid and sovereign deployment environments.
* Define availability, performance, scalability, backup and disaster-recovery requirements.
* Ensure technical designs comply with customer architecture standards, security policies and operational requirements.
* Define reusable components and shared technical services.

**4\. Microservices and Integration Architecture**

* Design microservices-based architectures using domain-driven design, API-first principles and event-driven patterns.
* Define service boundaries, APIs, integration contracts, data ownership and communication mechanisms.
* Design synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST APIs, API gateways, message brokers, event streaming and enterprise integration platforms.
* Recommend suitable containerization and orchestration approaches using Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent technologies.
* Define requirements for service discovery, centralized configuration, secrets management, monitoring, logging, tracing and fault tolerance.
* Address scalability, availability, performance, security and disaster-recovery requirements.
* Support the modernization of legacy applications and monolithic systems.
* Recommend suitable CI/CD, DevSecOps and automated testing approaches.
* Define API governance, versioning, security and lifecycle-management practices.

**5\. Artificial Intelligence Solutions**

* Identify and define practical AI and generative AI use cases based on customer requirements.
* Design AI solution architectures covering machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, forecasting, recommendation, classification and intelligent automation.
* Define generative AI solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge bases, fine-tuning and AI agents.
* Design AI integration approaches with customer systems, databases, APIs, documents and enterprise platforms.
* Define data preparation, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and continuous-improvement approaches.
* Address AI governance, privacy, security, explainability, bias, hallucination control and human approval requirements.
* Evaluate cloud-based, on-premises and hybrid AI deployment options.
* Support AI demonstrations, pilots, prototypes and proof-of-concepts.
* Estimate infrastructure, storage, compute and GPU requirements for AI workloads.
* Define measurable AI success criteria, expected business value and operational outcomes.

**6\. Data and Business Intelligence Solutions**

* Design business intelligence, analytics, reporting and data-visualization solutions.
* Define data integration and processing approaches using ETL, ELT, APIs, streaming and data pipelines.
* Design conceptual architectures for data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, operational data stores and analytical platforms.
* Identify data sources, data-quality requirements, metadata, master data and governance considerations.
* Define dashboards, KPIs, executive reports, operational reports and self-service analytics capabilities.
* Recommend suitable BI and analytics platforms based on customer requirements.
* Work with business stakeholders to ensure KPIs and reports support measurable objectives.
* Define requirements for data access, security, lineage, retention, classification and quality monitoring.
* Support analytical use cases such as forecasting, segmentation, trend analysis and performance monitoring.
* Ensure BI solutions provide accurate, timely and trusted information.

* Design and support solutions for telecom operators, service providers and communication organizations.
* Understand telecom customer journeys, digital channels, customer care, billing, charging, order management, product catalogues, service fulfilment and service assurance.
* Understand how customer-facing telecom systems integrate with network and operational platforms.
* Support solution design across Business Support Systems and Operations Support Systems.
* Understand common telecom domains, including:

* Customer relationship management
* Product and service catalogues
* Order management
* Billing and charging
* Payments and collections
* Customer self-service applications
* Service provisioning and activation
* Network and service inventory
* Fault and alarm management
* Performance monitoring
* Service assurance
* Field-service operations

* Design integrations between digital channels, customer platforms, billing systems, order-management systems and network-service platforms.
* Understand telecom APIs, integration platforms and event-driven architecture.
* Apply TM Forum concepts and Open APIs where relevant.
* Support telecom use cases involving customer experience, loyalty, churn prediction, personalized recommendations, fraud detection, network analytics and intelligent customer care.
* Understand telecom operational KPIs, service-quality indicators and customer-experience measurements.
* Address telecom security, regulatory, data-residency and operational requirements.
* Prepare architecture designs, technical proposals and demonstrations for telecom customers.
* Communicate effectively with telecom business, enterprise architecture, IT, data, cybersecurity and network stakeholders.

**8\. Technical Proposal Development**

* Lead the preparation of complete technical proposals and tender responses.
* Develop and review proposal sections including:

* Executive summary
* Understanding of customer requirements
* Proposed solution
* Solution architecture
* Scope of work
* Deliverables
* Implementation methodology
* Project phases and schedule
* Team structure and responsibilities
* Assumptions and dependencies
* Risks and mitigation actions
* Service-level requirements
* Security and compliance
* Support and maintenance
* Training and knowledge transfer
* Compliance matrices
* Bill of quantities
* Technical appendices

* Ensure proposals are accurate, consistent, persuasive, compliant and professionally presented.
* Maintain traceability between customer requirements and the proposed solution.
* Review contributions from internal teams, vendors, subcontractors and technology partners.
* Ensure the final proposal clearly communicates business value, technical feasibility and competitive differentiation.
* Manage technical proposal reviews and obtain the required internal approvals.
* Ensure all technical commitments, deliverables and schedules are realistic and achievable.
* Verify that proposed technologies and products are properly licensed, supported and available.

**9\. Costing and Commercial Support**

* Develop effort estimates for analysis, architecture, design, development, integration, testing, deployment, support and project management.
* Prepare resource plans, role descriptions, competency requirements and estimated person-days.
* Support the preparation of bills of quantities and technical costing assumptions.
* Work with finance and sales to validate resource costs, infrastructure costs, licensing costs, partner costs, margins and contingencies.
* Identify potential commercial risks, hidden costs and out-of-scope items.
* Support fixed-price, time-and-material, managed-service, staff-augmentation and subscription-based proposals.
* Ensure the proposed scope is commercially achievable and technically deliverable.
* Validate partner and vendor quotations.
* Recommend suitable contingency levels based on technical, delivery and dependency risks.
* Clearly document pricing assumptions, exclusions and dependencies.
* Support value engineering and cost-optimization activities without compromising the required quality.

**10\. Customer Engagement and Presentations**

* Present proposed solutions to customer executives, business stakeholders, architects, security teams and technical evaluators.
* Lead technical clarification meetings, discovery workshops, demonstrations and solution walkthroughs.
* Explain complex technical concepts in clear business language.
* Respond to customer questions, concerns and objections confidently and accurately.
* Demonstrate the business value, feasibility, scalability and differentiation of the proposed solution.
* Build trusted relationships with customer technical and business stakeholders.
* Support negotiations and technical discussions until contract award.
* Participate in technical evaluation sessions and defend the proposed solution.
* Prepare presentation materials, architecture visuals and technical demonstrations.
* Support customer meetings related to scope, assumptions, dependencies and delivery approach.

**11\. Proof-of-Concept and Demonstration Management**

* Define the scope, success criteria, architecture, timeline and required resources for demonstrations and proof-of-concepts.
* Coordinate with engineering, AI, data, DevOps, product and delivery teams.
* Ensure demonstrations are aligned with customer priorities and evaluation criteria.
* Document proof-of-concept results, limitations, dependencies and recommendations.
* Convert successful proof-of-concepts into realistic implementation plans.
* Ensure reusable demonstration assets are documented and maintained.
* Define the required data, environments, integrations and access for each demonstration.
* Manage customer expectations regarding proof-of-concept scope, limitations and outcomes.
* Present proof-of-concept findings and recommendations to customer stakeholders.

**12\. Partner and Vendor Management**

* Engage technology vendors, cloud providers, product companies and implementation partners.
* Request technical inputs, quotations, licensing details, architecture guidance and compliance documentation.
* Evaluate partner capabilities, proposed resources, delivery models and technical solutions.
* Ensure partner contributions align with the overall architecture and proposal.
* Identify technical, delivery and commercial gaps in third-party proposals.
* Maintain accountability for the completeness and quality of the final integrated solution.
* Coordinate joint solution development and proposal preparation.
* Validate that partner commitments, schedules and deliverables are clearly documented.
* Escalate partner delays or quality issues that may affect proposal submission or delivery feasibility.

**13\. Security, Governance and Compliance**

* Ensure proposed solutions address security, privacy and regulatory requirements.
* Define identity and access management, encryption, audit logging, data protection and API-security requirements.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to address security controls and customer compliance requirements.
* Consider applicable Saudi regulations, cybersecurity controls and data-hosting requirements.
* Ensure AI and data solutions follow appropriate governance principles.
* Identify security-related assumptions, risks and dependencies.
* Support the completion of security and compliance questionnaires.
* Ensure secure architecture principles are incorporated from the proposal stage.
* Address data classification, residency, retention and sovereignty requirements.

**14\. Presales-to-Delivery Handover**

* Conduct a structured handover from presales to delivery after contract award.
* Explain the agreed scope, assumptions, deliverables, architecture, schedule, risks, resource plan and contractual commitments.
* Ensure delivery teams understand all technical and commercial boundaries.
* Participate in project kickoff and early-stage architecture validation.
* Support delivery teams in resolving significant gaps between the proposal and implementation requirements.
* Document lessons learned and improvement actions for future opportunities.
* Ensure all proposal documents, estimates and customer clarifications are transferred to the delivery team.
* Maintain continuity between the proposed solution and the delivered solution.
* Ensure changes identified after award are managed through the appropriate change-control process.

* Develop reusable proposal templates, architecture patterns, solution accelerators, estimations and compliance responses.
* Maintain a knowledge repository for technologies, products, telecom use cases and previous proposals.
* Monitor market developments and emerging technologies related to digital solutions, microservices, AI, data, BI and telecom.
* Share knowledge and best practices with presales, sales, architecture and delivery teams.
* Support internal capability development and technical enablement.
* Improve proposal quality, estimation accuracy and response efficiency.
* Contribute to the organization’s service offerings and solution portfolio.
* Maintain reusable architecture diagrams, case studies, references and demonstration materials.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of three years of experience working with telecom operators, telecom projects or telecom-related solutions.
* Proven experience responding to enterprise, government and telecom RFPs, RFIs and tenders.
* Demonstrated experience designing and presenting complex enterprise and telecom solutions.
* Experience working with technology vendors, system integrators, implementation partners and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

* Recommendation and forecasting

* Data modelling
* Data quality and governance
* Dashboards and data visualization
* KPIs and analytical reporting

* Strong presentation, demonstration and storytelling skills.

* Arabic communication skills are preferred for customer-facing roles in Saudi Arabia.

* Customer-focused and business-oriented.
* Accountable and results-driven.

FlyAkeed is an innovative online platform focused on transforming the travel booking experience by enabling seamless flight and hotel reservations. Established in 2017 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, we aim to simplify work-related travel planning for businesses and individuals alike.

Current funding stage: Series A

* Hands-on experience wit**h** **Storybook**.

* Experience designing AI-native products or developer tools.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design.
* Experience with product analytics and experimentation.
* Basic frontend development experience.
* Passion for emerging AI technologies and modern product development workflows.

### About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand their customers and take action across the entire customer lifecycle.

Our platform brings together products including Social Listening, OmniServe, Survey, and AI Agent, helping enterprise organizations across the region turn customer data into better experiences and measurable business outcomes.

As Lucidya continues to scale, our products are becoming more sophisticated and our customers more demanding. Design has an increasingly important role to play in making sure that complexity doesn't become the customer's problem.

### Why this role matters

At this level, we're looking for someone who can move beyond simply executing designs and **own problems from beginning to end**.

You'll take ambiguous customer and business problems, work with Product and Engineering to understand what we're trying to achieve, explore different approaches, and drive the design through to implementation and iteration.

You'll be working on products that can involve significant amounts of data, complex workflows, AI-powered functionality, and bilingual experiences. The challenge isn't simply making these products look good — it's making them **easy to understand, efficient to use, and genuinely useful for enterprise customers**.

You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. The strongest person in this role will know when to push their own thinking, when to ask for input, and when to challenge an assumption.

### What You'll Do

* **Own design problems end-to-end.** You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration.
* **Turn ambiguity into clarity.** Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve.
* **Design for outcomes, not outputs.** You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working.
* **Partner closely with Product and Engineering.** You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer.
* **Raise the quality of our products.** You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different.
* **Bring customer evidence into design decisions.** You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion.
* **Make complex products feel simple.** Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster.
* **Design thoughtfully for our market.** You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region.
* **Communicate your thinking clearly.** You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only *what* you designed but *why* you made those decisions.
* **Make the team better.** You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area.

**Requirements**

### Who You Are

* **You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step.** You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward.
* **You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer.** You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished.
* **You're comfortable challenging the status quo.** If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence.
* **You know when to push and when to compromise.** You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints.
* **You're highly collaborative.** You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process.
* **You're comfortable with ambiguity and change.** Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process.
* **You're genuinely curious about users.** You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong.
* **You communicate with clarity.** You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive.
* **You care about quality.** You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when “good enough to learn” is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated.
* **You have 3–5 years of product design or UX/UI experience**, ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking.
* **You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices.**
* **You're a Saudi national**, as this position is designated for Saudi nationals.

### Nice to Have

* Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products.
* Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents.
* Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences.
* Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools.

### What the hiring process will look like

1.  **Recruiter screening** — An initial conversation about your experience, motivations, and what you're looking for next.
2.  **Design interview** — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems.
3.  **Portfolio / case study presentation** — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes.
4.  **Team / culture interview** — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team.
5.  **Final interview** — Final conversation with the relevant leadership team.

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate.

You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them.

No two days are the same, but you should expect to:

- Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points.

- Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region.

- Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions.

- Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations.

- Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness.

- Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

- Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models.

- Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers.

- Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

- Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

- Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies.

REQUIREMENTS

- Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations.

- People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.

- Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building.

- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

- Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications.

- Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact.

- Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Saudi Arabia or UAE. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Arabic and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

description:
**Whether you’re an experienced professional or just getting started, your contributions matter at Fortra. If you’re passionate about tackling meaningful challenges alongside talented team members committed to helping each other succeed, all while having lots of fun, we want to hear from you. We offer competitive benefits and salaries, personal and professional development opportunities, flexibility, and much more!**

Fortra’s Solutions Engineer's, also known as Presales Consultant/Engineer or Sales Engineer, are known as the trusted advisor's that expertly identify optimal solutions for our customer’s needs. It is an exciting opportunity for experienced professionals possessing strong technical skills, openness and team collaboration, and excellent presentation skills that help drive sales activities and business development.  
  
You will work with leading companies for our global company, providing guidance during the sales process by identifying customers technical and business requirements and demonstrating product capabilities. You willl also be responsible for designing a solution proposal that is the best for the customer. Solutions Engineering is a fantastic role to interact and learn from multiple teams including sales, business partners, professional services, marketing, technical support and product development. Some of these activities may require traveling occasionally to meet customers and business partners on their premises, as well as participating in tradeshows or events.

## WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Be a team with sales representatives and work together on any activities with prospective customers and business partners.
* Conduct “pain discovery” processes to understand the customer needs and articulate a solution that best addresses that need. Ability to understand the customer’s current environment and business problems.
* Deliver technical presentations and respond to technical questions during sales calls.
* Develop, present and deliver high-impact solution demonstrations.
* Design secure, scalable solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Be the owner for our customer’s evaluation process of the offered products and solutions.
* Plan and manage proofs of concept, including scope, success criteria, timelines, customer responsibilities, and technical validation.
* Detect technical and functional objections from the prospective customer during the sales process, be creative finding solutions, and work together with the appropriate team for remediation.
* Build and defend proposals to customers, articulating the benefits of our company as the best solution that addresses that need to all levels, including “C” level executives.
* Support responses to RFPs, RFIs, security questionnaires, and technical tender requirements.
* Work together on partners activities like discovery calls, demos, proposals, events and others.
* Participate in partner enablement activities like tech training and functional enablement.
* Collaborate with product management, engineering, support, and professional services to resolve technical issues and represent regional customer needs.
* Represent the Company at Trade Shows, User Group events, Conferences, and Virtual webinar events.
* Serve as the market expert on products, from how customers use them, to how the competition positions against them, to how the field sells and services them.

## QUALIFICATIONS

* Four-year Degree in a technical field, ideally Computer Science or IT is preferred, or adequate career experience.
* 3+ years of experience in IT on at least one of the following areas: technical presales, technical consultancy, development or technical support activities.
* Excellent oral presentation skills, public relations skills, and the ability to educate and train in a technical environment.
* General knowledge of several technologies such as: SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, SQL, SMB; NAS, DNS, proxies, load balancers, LDAP, SAML, API, web services, JSON, XML, Windows, Linux, cloud providers, hybrid infrastructure and containerized deployments.
* Previous experience in workflow development or scripting, in any language.
* Security fundamentals: Encryption, PKI, authentication, authorization, certificates, key management, network security, Anti-malware, Data Loss Prevention, compliance and secure deployment practices
* Working effectively with partners and distributors across the Middle East
* Ability to work independently in a regional role while collaborating effectively with international and remote teams.
* Willingness to travel occasionally. In a normal year, you might expect to travel 1-3 times per quarter.
* Previous experience in MFT, data integration or job scheduling solutions is a plus.

description:
At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. We turn what's complex into something simple, powerful, and scalable.

Catalog is the layer underneath everything. Storefronts, search, recommendations, landing pages, and every channel a merchant sells through all read from the same product data. When it is good, every surface above it gets better at once. When it is thin or wrong, nothing built on top can fix it.

Two things make this exciting:.

First, Salla does not build the catalog. Merchants do, and often not even the merchant: a freelancer, operations staff, an outsourced agency. Every surface we build inherits what those hands produce. So the question is not how to clean the data. It is how you change what someone produces when they do not work for you and mostly want to finish and move on.

Second, no two categories need the same product record. What a fashion merchant needs is not what a pharmacy, a grocer, or a gold merchant needs. The easy answer is to build each category separately, and it does not scale.

You will drive impact across five areas

* The Catalog Engine and Category Setup (one engine, built once, with what each category needs from a product record expressed as configuration rather than code, so supporting one more category is fast and repeatable)
* Product Data Input (creation, bulk import, editing, and everything that happens at the moment someone types or uploads)
* Structure and Meaning (taxonomy, attributes, variants, identifiers, normalization, and duplicates)
* AI Enrichment (extracting and generating product data from what merchants already have, with a clear position on confidence, review, and correction)
* Downstream Fitness (how this data actually performs where it is consumed: search results, storefronts, recommendations, and external channel feeds)

### Responsibilities:

* Own the catalog strategy end to end: sequence it into quarters, defend it in the room, and hold it accountable to the numbers it promised.
* Own the roadmap for how product data gets created and improved on Salla, prioritized on whether the data works downstream rather than on how many fields are filled.
* Design for the people who actually do the work, including the ones who do not own the store, and make the good path the fastest path rather than a longer one enforced by rules.
* Keep a new category, a configuration change rather than an engineering project, and be able to show the difference in effort between the first one and the next.
* Put AI to work where it earns trust: decide what we generate outright, what we suggest for approval, and what we never touch, with a stated confidence policy and a loop that learns from every correction a merchant makes.
* Define what catalog quality means at Salla and instrument it honestly, tied to the surfaces that consume the data rather than to completeness for its own sake.
* Own how product data performs in external selling channels, where the requirements are strict and the rejections are visible.
* Decide how much structure we impose and where merchants stay free, then defend that line against pressure from both directions.
* Lead 2 to 3 product managers: give them real ownership, coach their framing and craft, run a reliable cadence, and raise the quality bar of what the group ships.
* Work as one system with the teams that depend on this data: search and discovery, storefronts, vendors, marketplace, and data.

**Requirements**

* Six or more years in product management, including work on a self-serve platform where users created their own content or data and you were accountable for the quality of what they produced.
* A number you owned and moved on that data: completeness that meant something, accuracy, time to publish, adoption of a data tool, or the performance of that data somewhere downstream.
* Evidence that you changed what users produced at the moment they produced it, rather than cleaning it up afterwards in a pipeline. We will ask which one it was.
* Platform judgment: you have built something once and made it serve many cases through configuration, and you can explain where you drew the line between what was shared and what was specific, and what that choice cost you.
* AI in production for structured data: extraction, classification, generation, or matching. You can talk concretely about confidence thresholds, error rates, what you let through automatically, and what you did when it was wrong at scale.
* Literacy in how product data is actually structured: taxonomies, attribute schemas, variants, identifiers, matching and deduplication, and the strict requirements external selling channels impose.

description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

In alignment with the Vision 2030 of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Visa is delighted to offer opportunities for Cooperative Training to Saudi students! This program is designed to successfully blend academic learning with practical work experience, providing the perfect platform for students to apply theoretical knowledge in a real-world setting. It is a crucial component of our recruitment strategy and our dedication to unlocking talent in Saudi Arabia!

Joining an international industry leader such as Visa is an experience that will enrich you personally and professionally. We have designed a detailed learning journey that will aid your development and set you up for success in your career.

Opportunities available in the following 4 departments: Consulting, Business Development, Finance & Marketing.

**Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA):**

VCA is the payments consulting arm of Visa, focused on serving Visa’s clients and partners. We offer consulting and analytics services across different areas of interest to our clients including strategy, product, portfolio management, risk, digital and more.

Within VCA, we have a dedicated Data Science team who are passionate about statistics, advanced analytics and machine learning with best-in-class access to insights from VisaNet, one of the largest payment networks in the world.

**Business Development (BD)**

The business development team drives the country strategy and its objectives by identifying, leading, and driving, through analytics, data and market intelligence, on opportunities to drive business growth for Visa and its clients. As a BD COOP Trainee, you will provide support to the team, assisting with client requests with the purpose to grow Visa share of business.

**Marketing**

The team focuses on driving awareness, preference and conversion across B2B and B2C. They build the brand, with a client centric approach, by reinforcing emotional affinity via innovation and tangible proof points. This is an opportunity to use your creativity, express ideas, and make a real contribution to the organization and its mission.

**Finance**

As a Finance intern, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced global payments environment while contributing to meaningful business projects from day one. You may support teams across deals, pricing, financial planning, controllership, help analyze financial data, identify trends, and provide insights that support business decisions. Your work could include assisting analysis of balance sheet and cash flow drivers, building stress-testing scenarios, reviewing financial results and variances, and helping ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial data.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

• Must be available for a full-time COOP starting in January 2027 (2nd semester COOP only)

• Current student working towards a Bachelors degree, with a graduation date of 2027. Must be available for a full-time graduate role in September 2027

• Must be well-versed and curious on the latest AI tools    
• Economics / Financial Economics, Marketing, Business, Finance, IT/MIS, and Engineering disciplines welcome to apply  
• Excellent academic record  
• Saudi National   
• Strong in MS Excel, Word & PowerPoint

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

  

If you thrive on rapid growth and enjoy working alongside positive, driven teammates, you’ll feel right at home here.

Help us to uplift everyone, everywhere. Whether you’re starting your career, pushing your capabilities or are a seasoned professional, learn how we can partner to reimagine the world.

  

Introduce yourself to our recruiters and we'll get in touch if there's a role that seems like a good match.

  

At Visa, we are driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. Our evolving technology keeps us at the heart of the digital economy, connecting people to 80+ million businesses worldwide. Backed by a resilient, proven model, our expanding network fuels growth—for Visa and for your career.

  

**Your journey starts here — discover how we hire**

Ready to take the next step? Learn more about life at Visa, explore our hiring process and get first-hand insights by hearing directly from our recruiters about what to expect. Apply with confidence today!

As Trainee - Improvement Process, you will be responsible for learning and onboarding in various programs and functions across the organization in 6 months spells, seeking to further comprehension of the company and its workings for accelerated growth and progression within the organization. * Collect and validate project data and assist in preparing project documentation.

**Process Analysis & Optimization**

  

* Conduct process mapping and value stream mapping exercises.
