* Assist in monitoring improvement actions and sustainability plans.

  

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret operational data.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools.
* Support performance reviews by providing trend analysis and improvement insights.
* Maintain project trackers and improvement databases.

  

**Problem Solving**

  

* Participate in structured problem-solving activities using:
    * PDCA
    * DMAIC
    * 5 Why Analysis
    * Fishbone Diagram
    * Pareto Analysis
    * A3 Problem Solving
* Assist teams in investigating root causes and implementing corrective actions.

  

**Lean & Six Sigma Deployment**

  

* Support Lean awareness and training programs.
* Participate in Kaizen events, Gemba walks, and workshops.
* Assist in promoting a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement.
* Support Lean Six Sigma certification activities and project reviews.

  

**Documentation & Governance**

  

* Maintain improvement project records and lessons learned.
* Support development of work instructions, standard operating procedures, and best practices.
* Ensure compliance with company quality, safety, and environmental requirements.
* You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background**

  

* A bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Software engineering, Computer Science and, Management Information Systems or a related field.

* Proficiency in both spoken & written in English & Arabic language is required.

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. description:
# ******Job Description Summary******

At GE Vernova, early careers are built through learning, curiosity, and hands-on experience. As an Early Career Trainee with GE Vernova Grid Solutions, you will grow with supportive teams while contributing to projects that help build a more reliable, resilient, and sustainable grid.  
This program is designed for recent graduates and early-career professionals who are eager to gain practical experience in customer project engineering. The trainee will support high-voltage GIS substation and synchronous condenser projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia while developing technical, coordination, and project execution skills.

# **Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support engineering activities and deliverables in line with project requirements, technical specifications, applicable standards, and safety expectations.

* Assist with layouts, schematics, technical documents, bills of quantities, customer submissions, and follow-up of open engineering actions.

* Work with multidisciplinary engineering teams and support coordination with customers, suppliers, site teams, and project stakeholders.

* Participate in technical meetings, design reviews, clarification sessions, training, and site visits with guidance from experienced engineers.

* Contribute to quality, EHS awareness, Lean, and continuous improvement activities by sharing observations, lessons learned, and improvement ideas.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Fresh graduate or early-career professional with up to 2 years of relevant experience.
* Interest in substations, power systems, GIS, rotating machines, power plants, FACTS, or related infrastructure projects.
* Curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to work effectively in a multicultural project environment.
* Good communication skills in English.
* Ability to live and work in Riyadh and travel within Saudi Arabia as needed.
* The legal right to work in KSA without company sponsorship or time restriction.

# ******Additional Information******

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

  

Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our singular mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it.

If we want our energy future to be different…we must be different.

Our mission is embedded in our name. We retain our treasured legacy, “GE,” in our name as an enduring and hard-earned badge of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” / “verde” signal Earth’s verdant and lush ecosystems. “Nova,” from the Latin “novus,” nods to a new, innovative era of lower carbon energy that GE Vernova will help deliver.

Together, we have The Energy to Change the World. [www.gevernova.com](http://www.gevernova.com/)

description:
Job Description

Senior Consultant, Program Management - AI Infrastructure Services
Today, every organization needs to be digital, powered by data, operating in a multi-cloud world and ready to adapt to whatever comes next. Our Consulting team assesses customers' strategic, organizational and business challenges, applying deep industry expertise to deliver technical solutions that enable business transformation, operational excellence and measurable outcomes.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Consultant on our Professional Services team in Saudi Arabia.
What You'll Achieve
As a Senior Consultant, Program Manager within AI Infrastructure Services, you will lead the delivery of large-scale AI and Data Center transformation programs for some of Dell Technologies' most strategic customers globally. You will help customers optimize Data Center design, accelerate AI infrastructure deployments and realize business value through complex multi-site implementation programs.
Working across Dell Technologies' products, services and partner ecosystem, you will be accountable for the successful delivery of our most complex programs. You will define program governance, establish delivery frameworks, manage interdependencies across multiple workstreams and ensure alignment to customer objectives and business outcomes.
You will provide leadership and oversight throughout the program lifecycle, driving effective decision-making, managing risks and ensuring stakeholder alignment. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging with executive leadership and C-Suite stakeholders, using a data-driven approach to provide transparency, influence outcomes and drive successful program delivery.
This role will lead and manage the Program Office on behalf of Dell Technologies for some of our largest global customers.

You Will
Establish and lead program governance and delivery assurance practices to ensure high-quality project execution and customer outcomes.
Manage large, complex portfolios of projects and programs, ensuring delivery on time, within budget and in line with customer expectations.
Develop and manage RAID logs, change control processes, escalation management and executive reporting.
Act as the primary point of contact for executive and management communications across assigned programs.
Lead cross-functional, globally distributed teams spanning Dell Technologies, customer organizations and third-party partners.
Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
Drive alignment across technical, operational and business teams to ensure successful implementation and realization of business value.
Provide coaching, mentoring and leadership to project and program teams.

Essential Requirements
Extensive experience leading large-scale programs and complex project delivery organizations with Program Management certifications (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent).
Proven track record delivering complex Data Center infrastructure and IT services programs across multiple customers, sites, geographies and workstreams.
Extensive hands-on Data Center infrastructure experience, including knowledge of: Power and cooling systems
Racks and physical infrastructure
Cabling and connectivity
Compute, storage and networking environments
Data Center operational readiness and deployment activities

Proven experience supporting the design, build, deployment, commissioning or expansion of enterprise, colocation, hyperscale or AI-focused Data Centers.
Strong understanding of AI infrastructure deployment and Data Center modernization initiatives.
Demonstrated success operating within complex matrix organizations and leading globally distributed teams.
Extensive experience presenting complex technical, operational and program delivery updates to C-Suite and senior executive stakeholders.
Strong commercial awareness and ability to manage delivery risks, stakeholder expectations and business outcomes.
Self-motivated, hands-on and capable of operating effectively under pressure while managing competing priorities.
Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills across technical, operational and executive audiences.
Proven ability to operate independently while leading high-performing, cross-functional teams.
Experience working within global organizations and multinational customer environments.
Willingness and ability to travel extensively across EMEA during customer deployment and commissioning phases. The successful candidate should be comfortable spending extended periods on customer sites supporting Data Center implementation, operational readiness and infrastructure build activities.

Desirable Requirements
Proficiency in English and at least one additional European language is an advantage.

Who We Are

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

Visit our Culture Code page to learn more about how we work and lead.

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager based in Saudi Arabia.**

This contract opportunity is ideal for a technically experienced professional who excels at coordinating complex engineering initiatives and improving delivery processes. You will support engineering leadership by overseeing work across central services, DevOps, and data teams in a real-money gaming environment. Your mission will be to bring clarity, structure, and accountability to engineering operations while ensuring priorities and releases remain aligned. You will combine software engineering expertise with program management, automation, and data-driven reporting to improve how teams collaborate. You will also lead a small team of contract engineers and help establish scalable workflows. By leveraging APIs, dashboards, and AI-powered tools, you will reduce manual coordination and increase visibility across the engineering landscape.

### Accountabilities:

You will coordinate cross-functional engineering delivery, improve operational efficiency, and ensure teams have clear priorities, ownership, and visibility into progress.

* Manage intake and triage for central services, DevOps, and data teams, determining request ownership, priorities, and delivery timelines.
    
* Maintain a consolidated view of ongoing initiatives to coordinate parallel work, prevent conflicts, and protect delivery outcomes.
    
* Track releases and communicate what has shipped, what is rolling out, and what is blocked, providing clear explanations of delivery decisions.
    
* Identify stalled initiatives, resolve bottlenecks, and proactively address issues that could affect delivery.
    
* Lead a small team of contract engineers working across central services and data, including setting priorities, conducting one-on-one meetings, and providing performance feedback.
    
* Automate operational workflows by integrating systems through APIs, connecting tools, and reducing manual status tracking.
    
* Develop consolidated dashboards that provide visibility into applications, infrastructure, data systems, and release progress, bringing together information from multiple sources.
    
* Integrate AI tools into engineering workflows to improve productivity, coordination, and decision-making.
    
* Oversee core delivery practices, including planning, commitments, retrospectives, release ownership, and accountability.
    

**Requirements:**

You should bring a strong technical foundation, practical delivery leadership experience, and a proactive approach to automation. The ideal candidate can engage with engineers as a technical peer while keeping projects organized, stakeholders informed, and teams focused on the right priorities.

* Professional software development experience, with a subsequent focus on technical program management or delivery coordination.
    
* Ability to read code, write scripts, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams; no specific programming language is required.
    
* Demonstrated ability to automate workflows, call APIs, integrate tools, and build reporting solutions independently.
    
* Practical experience using AI tools extensively, with sound judgment about their strengths, limitations, and appropriate applications.
    
* Experience managing delivery or release reporting for a team that ships software regularly.
    
* Previous experience leading engineers or a small technical team, including setting priorities and supporting team performance.
    
* Strong prioritization skills and the ability to distinguish genuine urgency from competing demands.
    
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions and communicate progress clearly.
    
* A calm, dependable leadership style that encourages early communication and proactive problem-solving.
    

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with live-service products, real-money gaming, or regulated products.
    
* Familiarity with mobile release management, including Apple App Store and Google Play processes.
    
* Experience administering Jira or Confluence.
    
* Knowledge of incident response and on-call practices.
    
* Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
    

**Benefits:**

* Contract-based engagement.
    
* Opportunity to work across central services, DevOps, data, and engineering operations.
    
* Hands-on ownership of automation, reporting, and delivery improvement initiatives.
    
* Opportunity to lead a small team of contract engineers.
    
* Exposure to AI-enabled engineering workflows and a complex, real-money gaming technology environment.
    
* Compensation, healthcare, paid leave, and other benefits are not specified in the provided job description.

**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**

  

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

  

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

  

**Role Overview:**  
Help organizations in Saudi Arabia improve customer experiences through cloud and AI-powered solutions. As a Solution Consultant at Genesys, you will work alongside Sales and technical teams to understand customer needs, demonstrate Genesys Cloud capabilities, and help design solutions that deliver meaningful business value.

Arabic fluency is a mandatory requirement for this customer-facing role. You will gain hands-on exposure to Genesys AI, automation, experience orchestration, integrations, and cloud technologies while developing your solution consulting skills and working with experienced colleagues and enterprise customers.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support customer discovery sessions to understand business needs, customer journeys, and technical requirements
* Design customer solutions using Genesys Cloud, AI capabilities, integrations, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Develop and deliver engaging demonstrations and presentations for business and technical audiences
* Identify relevant AI use cases across self-service, agent assistance, personalization, analytics, and automation
* Partner with Sales and technical specialists to support opportunities throughout the sales cycle
* Support business cases and RFx responses by connecting proposed solutions with customer value
* Build trusted customer relationships while developing knowledge of Genesys products and customer experience best practices

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Arabic fluency is mandatory for this role, with strong English communication skills also required
* Bachelor's degree or 1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience
* Strong interest in technology, AI, cloud solutions, and customer experience
* Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
* Ability to collaborate effectively across customer, sales, and technical teams
* Ability to travel up to 50%

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to AI, SaaS, CCaaS, cloud platforms, or customer experience technologies
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, APIs, software implementation, integrations, or coding
* Knowledge of Genesys Cloud or Genesys AI
* Experience in a customer-facing, technical, consulting, or sales support environment

## Role Overview

As a **Business Process & AI Transformation Consultant**, you will help organizations reimagine business processes through the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies. You will assess industry trends, identify transformation opportunities, and design future-state operating models that integrate AI at scale. Working closely with business and technology leaders, you will define practical, scalable transformation strategies that drive operational efficiency, innovation, and business value.

## Key Responsibilities

* Assess industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technology developments to identify opportunities for AI-driven business transformation.
* Analyze current business processes and operating models to identify areas for optimization through AI and intelligent automation.
* Design future-state business processes that leverage AI, automation, and digital technologies to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
* Define AI integration points across business processes, systems, workflows, data sources, and decision-making activities.
* Develop detailed process transformation designs, including system interactions, data flows, automation requirements, and human-machine collaboration models.
* Recommend operating model changes that support sustainable AI adoption, including governance structures, roles, responsibilities, and performance measures.
* Facilitate alignment between business and technology stakeholders throughout transformation initiatives.
* Provide subject matter expertise on industry- and function-specific requirements, regulations, governance frameworks, and business practices.
* Support the development of transformation roadmaps, implementation strategies, and change management approaches.
* Communicate complex process, technology, and AI design decisions to senior leadership in a clear, business-focused manner.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure AI-enabled solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Promote best practices for AI adoption, process excellence, and continuous improvement across transformation programs.

## Job Qualifications

### Basic Qualifications

* **4-7 years of experience** in Business Transformation, Process Consulting, Management Consulting, Digital Transformation, Intelligent Automation, or related fields.
* Experience analyzing and redesigning business processes to improve operational performance and business outcomes.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and digital transformation principles.
* Experience developing target operating models, process frameworks, and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of business process design methodologies and process improvement techniques.
* Experience facilitating workshops and collaborating with business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting AI, automation, or enterprise transformation initiatives across one or more business functions or industries.
* Familiarity with process mining, workflow automation, business architecture, and operating model design.
* Knowledge of AI governance, compliance, risk management, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience documenting future-state processes, data flows, and system integration requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.
* Experience working with transformation tools, process modeling frameworks, and enterprise technology platforms.
* Relevant certifications in Business Analysis, Process Excellence, Lean Six Sigma, Change Management, or Digital Transformation are preferred.

**About Accenture**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

Visit us at [www.accenture.com](http://www.accenture.com/)

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

With us, you’ll continue to learn and grow so you can advance in your career. description:

Senior Consultant, Program Management - AI Infrastructure Services
Today, every organization needs to be digital, powered by data, operating in a multi-cloud world and ready to adapt to whatever comes next. Our Consulting team assesses customers' strategic, organizational and business challenges, applying deep industry expertise to deliver technical solutions that enable business transformation, operational excellence and measurable outcomes.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Consultant on our Professional Services team in Saudi Arabia.
What You'll Achieve
As a Senior Consultant, Program Manager within AI Infrastructure Services, you will lead the delivery of large-scale AI and Data Center transformation programs for some of Dell Technologies' most strategic customers globally. You will help customers optimize Data Center design, accelerate AI infrastructure deployments and realize business value through complex multi-site implementation programs.
Working across Dell Technologies' products, services and partner ecosystem, you will be accountable for the successful delivery of our most complex programs. You will define program governance, establish delivery frameworks, manage interdependencies across multiple workstreams and ensure alignment to customer objectives and business outcomes.
You will provide leadership and oversight throughout the program lifecycle, driving effective decision-making, managing risks and ensuring stakeholder alignment. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging with executive leadership and C-Suite stakeholders, using a data-driven approach to provide transparency, influence outcomes and drive successful program delivery.
This role will lead and manage the Program Office on behalf of Dell Technologies for some of our largest global customers.

You Will
Establish and lead program governance and delivery assurance practices to ensure high-quality project execution and customer outcomes.
Manage large, complex portfolios of projects and programs, ensuring delivery on time, within budget and in line with customer expectations.
Develop and manage RAID logs, change control processes, escalation management and executive reporting.
Act as the primary point of contact for executive and management communications across assigned programs.
Lead cross-functional, globally distributed teams spanning Dell Technologies, customer organizations and third-party partners.
Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
Drive alignment across technical, operational and business teams to ensure successful implementation and realization of business value.
Provide coaching, mentoring and leadership to project and program teams.

Essential Requirements
Extensive experience leading large-scale programs and complex project delivery organizations with Program Management certifications (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent).
Proven track record delivering complex Data Center infrastructure and IT services programs across multiple customers, sites, geographies and workstreams.
Extensive hands-on Data Center infrastructure experience, including knowledge of: Power and cooling systems
Racks and physical infrastructure
Cabling and connectivity
Compute, storage and networking environments
Data Center operational readiness and deployment activities

Proven experience supporting the design, build, deployment, commissioning or expansion of enterprise, colocation, hyperscale or AI-focused Data Centers.
Strong understanding of AI infrastructure deployment and Data Center modernization initiatives.
Demonstrated success operating within complex matrix organizations and leading globally distributed teams.
Extensive experience presenting complex technical, operational and program delivery updates to C-Suite and senior executive stakeholders.
Strong commercial awareness and ability to manage delivery risks, stakeholder expectations and business outcomes.
Self-motivated, hands-on and capable of operating effectively under pressure while managing competing priorities.
Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills across technical, operational and executive audiences.
Proven ability to operate independently while leading high-performing, cross-functional teams.
Experience working within global organizations and multinational customer environments.
Willingness and ability to travel extensively across EMEA during customer deployment and commissioning phases. The successful candidate should be comfortable spending extended periods on customer sites supporting Data Center implementation, operational readiness and infrastructure build activities.

Desirable Requirements
Proficiency in English and at least one additional European language is an advantage.

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

description:
Nabeh, a subsidiary of Master Works, delivers AI-powered solutions that help organizations automate operations, boost efficiency, and drive innovation. Its expertise spans computer vision, LLM applications, speech-to-text, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions.

Nabeh is looking for an **AI Project Manager, Senior** to lead the end-to-end delivery of AI, computer vision, Generative AI (GenAI), and intelligent-platform projects. The role is responsible for translating contractual commitments into secure, technically feasible, and measurable client outcomes while managing project scope, schedules, budgets, quality, risks, and formal acceptance. The Senior AI Project Manager will serve as the primary coordination point between clients, AI and engineering teams, infrastructure, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery and alignment with business objectives.

### Key Responsibilities

* Lead project initiation and handover from Sales, reviewing contracts, statements of work (SOWs), purchase orders (POs), deliverables, commercial milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Develop and maintain integrated project management plans, detailed schedules, milestones, forecasts, and approved project baselines, ensuring changes are documented and formally approved.
* Manage project kickoffs, stakeholder communication, risk and issue tracking, change requests, status reporting, steering committees, and escalation processes.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, contracts, approvals, deliverables, and correspondence, ensuring records are organized and audit-ready.
* Coordinate the end-to-end AI delivery lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, data preparation, model development or configuration, integration, deployment, user acceptance testing (UAT), go-live, and hyper care.
* Track AI model performance requirements and success measures, including precision, recall, false positives, inference latency, operational monitoring, and retraining requirements, where applicable.
* Monitor readiness of datasets, development environments, GPUs, edge devices, camera streams, APIs, cloud or on-premises infrastructure, cybersecurity reviews, licenses, and third-party integrations.
* Coordinate technical validation, security and privacy approvals, client UAT, production readiness, user training, handover, and service transition, ensuring the required evidence and technical sign-offs are obtained.
* Coordinate AI engineers, technical leads, DevOps, infrastructure, business analysts, QA, UI/UX, support, field teams, and subcontractors to align responsibilities, priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Monitor project progress, identify blockers and resource constraints, and coordinate recovery plans and escalations through PMO and functional leadership.
* Coordinate site readiness, permits, logistics, safety requirements, and vendor mobilization for field and edge AI deployments.
* Track project budgets, resource utilization, timesheets, vendor purchase orders, cost-to-complete, financial milestones, invoicing requirements, and potential margin exposure.
* Coordinate signed acceptance documents, completion certificates (CoCs), and supporting evidence required for timely invoicing and payment.
* Manage subcontractor deliverables, schedules, dependencies, and handovers, coordinating contractual and commercial changes with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and Legal.
* Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact for project delivery, communicating progress, issues, corrective actions, and decisions clearly and proactively in English and Arabic as required.
* Coordinate quality assurance activities, defect prioritization, UAT plans, issue resolution, user training, operational documentation, support service-level agreements (SLAs), and formal client acceptance.
* Lead project closure activities, including documentation handover, lessons learned, financial reconciliation, and transition to support or managed services.
* Prepare regular project status reports highlighting milestones, risks, budget status, delivery progress, outstanding actions, and issues requiring management attention.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of project delivery experience, including at least 2 years managing AI, analytics, computer vision, software/platform, or complex integration projects.
* Strong knowledge of project management practices aligned with PMI principles, including scope, schedule, risk, stakeholder, procurement, cost, quality, and change control.
* Experience managing Agile or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML delivery lifecycles and the technical dependencies involved in data, integrations, infrastructure, model validation, and production readiness.
* Experience working with enterprise clients, vendors, statements of work (SOWs), purchase orders (POs), project budgets, invoicing milestones, and formal acceptance processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; professional Arabic is highly desirable for client-facing project delivery in Saudi Arabia.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and project management tools such as MS Project and Jira.
* Strong leadership, organizational, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, project risks, deadlines, and cross-functional dependencies effectively.
* Ability to maintain accurate project documentation and handle confidential business and client information professionally.
* Willingness to work onsite with clients and travel within Saudi Arabia as project requirements dictate.

### Preferred Qualifications

* PMP or an equivalent project management certification.
* AI project management training or certification, such as CPMAI.
* Experience in smart cities, video analytics/CCTV, edge AI, Generative AI, cloud or on-premises deployments, or government-sector programs.
* Exposure to Saudi client environments, site and traffic-safety governance, data protection, and cybersecurity processes.
* Experience using enterprise project and resource management systems.

description:
Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies.
We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big!

Meet the team!
Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team.

As a Product Manager, Data & Insights, you will lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and analytics, responsible for delivering intuitive, reliable, and scalable reporting experiences for both external users and internal stakeholders.
You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities—from customer research and data modeling through to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. You will partner closely with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, supports compliance requirements, and delivers meaningful insights for executive decision-making.
You will also champion and lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products, ensuring that data is managed responsibly, securely, and in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements.

Help us shape the future of communication by:
Defining and executing the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collaborate with leadership to prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Be an advisor for other Product teams in data strategy and design.

Collecting business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

Developing detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs.

Partnering closely with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in the data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Understand schema design and how it impacts performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Influence architectural decisions around extract-transform-load (ETL/ELT) processes and dimensional modeling.

Owning and enforcing data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control.

Defining processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Be an advocate for data accuracy and a watchdog for misleading or incomplete insights.

Owning the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode).

Defining self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams. Create feedback loops to continually improve dashboard usability and relevance for both internal and external users.

Acting as the bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. CodeNinja is a tech and AI consulting firm delivering embedded and forward-deployed engineering and analytics teams across KSA, Pakistan, Egypt, and Latin America. We partner with leading banks, telcos, and enterprises to build data-driven, customer-centric capabilities.

### About the Role

We are hiring 2 hands-on CVM / Segmentation Specialists to support customer segmentation, profiling, and campaign targeting for a Retail Banking client. This is a hands-on execution role — not a strategy-only or purely advisory position — focused on turning customer data into actionable commercial insights that drive campaign performance.

### Key Responsibilities

* Build and maintain customer segmentation models based on behavior, value, and lifecycle stage
* Conduct customer profiling and behavioral analysis to identify targeting opportunities
* Support campaign targeting by translating segmentation outputs into actionable audience lists
* Analyze campaign performance and customer response, feeding insights back into segmentation logic
* Develop and maintain BI/reporting dashboards to track CVM metrics and campaign KPIs
* Collaborate with marketing, BI, and product teams to convert data into commercial actions
* Continuously refine segmentation frameworks based on performance data and business feedback

**Requirements**

### Must-Haves

* Strong background in Retail Banking / CVM analytics
* Hands-on experience building segmentation models (RFM, behavioral, value-based, etc.)
* Proven customer behavior analysis and profiling experience
* Strong BI/reporting skills (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar)
* Ability to translate data into actionable commercial/campaign recommendations
* 4–6 years of relevant experience.

### Nice-to-Haves

* Experience with campaign management platforms (SAS CI, Adobe Campaign, etc.)
* Exposure to predictive/propensity modeling
* Prior experience in a banking or telco CVM function specifically

### Why Join Us

* Work on high-impact, data-driven initiatives with a leading Retail Banking client
* Collaborative, hands-on environment with direct visibility into campaign outcomes
* Opportunity to shape segmentation strategy from the ground up

### Disclaimer

CodeNinja is an equal opportunity employer. This role is contingent on client approval and may be subject to change based on project requirements.

OVERVIEW OF 73 STRINGS:
73 Strings is an innovative platform providing comprehensive data extraction, monitoring, and valuation solutions for the private capital industry. The company's AI-powered platform streamlines middle-office processes for alternative investments, enabling seamless data structuring and standardization, monitoring, and fair value estimation at the click of a button. 73 Strings serves clients globally across various strategies, including Private Equity, Growth Equity, Venture Capital, Infrastructure and Private Credit.
Our 2025 $55M Series B, the largest in the industry, was led by Goldman Sachs, with participation from Golub Capital and Hamilton Lane, with continued support from Blackstone, Fidelity International Strategic Ventures and Broadhaven Ventures.

Role and Background:
This role is open to Saudi nationals only

We are looking for an enthusiastic and energetic Associate to join our team of talented engineers and experienced financial advisory & valuation professionals. This is a FinTech role and you would be bringing your strong Valuation skills into the Technology and AI space.

Working as an Associate at 73 Strings means you will work on functional valuation aspects, required in building products that use cutting edge technology to deliver innovative solutions for the financial services industry and managing the clients independently. Be one of the first to explore the unchartered territories at the intersection of AI and Corporate Finance.
Responsibilities

• Flexibility to work from our clients site in Riyadh 5 days a week

• Work with the product development team on developing the various equity valuation products/features we are building for the financial advisory industry

• Oversea/review complex portfolio valuations, equity waterfalls, and various financial and statistical models

• Managing multiple clients independently and interacting with them (private equity/ venture capital/etc.)

• Flexibility to work from client site in Riyadh 5 days a week

• Provide demo and oversea proof-of-concept assignments for prospective clients

• Oversea/review portfolio valuation related projects, business research and valuation projects. Enhance relevant sources of data that can help fuel the analysis by our AI-powered platform and evaluate the quality, cost, and coverage of these databases

• Train the Product and the technology team in understanding important concepts in valuation, business research and corporate finance so that they can develop effective algorithms and workflows to automate these tasks

• Oversea testing of the overall platform performance and measure the accuracy of the platform to build and suggest improvements.

• Deliver in-depth research reports on various companies and funds operating in a variety of different industries and countries to clients across geographies.

• Train and lead the functional team on all aspects of valuations, product development, project management and client engagement.

Qualifications

• Graduate or post-graduate qualification in Finance/Statistics.

• CA/CPA, CFA, MBA or equivalent

• Must have worked a minimum of 2 years for a top tier valuation firm, i.e., Big 4s.

• Client facing skills

• Fluent in Arabic and English

• Critical thinking and time management

• A good understanding of Financial Statements and should know how to analyze them.

• Advanced research skills.

• Understanding of various methodologies and approaches of valuations, cap tables, allocation waterfalls.

• Understanding the Metrics used by Private Equity in their decision-making.

• Fluency in Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

• Strong written, verbal communication skills.

• Capable collaborator.

They are committed to fostering a welcoming and collaborative work environment that encourages big-picture thinking, brings out the best in their personnel, and helps them develop innovative solutions that contribute to building a better world together. If this sounds like a culture you would like to work in, you are invited to apply for this role.
Client is looking for an Advanced Work Package (AWP) Coordinator
Project Type : Mining & Metals
Location: Ras Al-Khair, Saudi Arabia
Requirements/Qualification:
+ Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
+ Minimum 8-12 years of experience in project execution, construction planning, project controls, or workface planning within industrial projects.
+ Minimum 3-5 years of direct experience implementing or coordinating Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) methodologies.
+ Proven experience on large-scale Mining & Metals, Metals Recycling, Minerals Processing, Manufacturing, Chemical Processing, or Heavy Industrial Projects.
+ Strong understanding of engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and project delivery processes.
+ Proficiency in Primavera P6, workface planning tools, and project control systems.
+ Knowledge of Construction Industry Institute (CII) AWP principles and best practices preferred.
+ Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams in EPC/EPCM environments.
+ Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
+ AWP, PMP, PSP, or equivalent project controls certification is preferred.
Preferred Experience:
+ Metals recycling facilities.
+ Battery recycling and black mass processing plants.
+ Hydrometallurgical or pyrometallurgical processing projects.
+ Large greenfield industrial developments.
+ Complex EPC/EPCM execution environments.
+ Middle East project experience.
Responsibilities:
+ Lead the implementation and execution of the Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) methodology across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.
+ Develop and maintain Construction Work Packages (CWPs), Engineering Work Packages (EWPs), Installation Work Packages (IWPs), and related execution plans.
+ Coordinate with engineering, procurement, project controls, construction, and commissioning teams to ensure work packages are released in accordance with project priorities and construction sequences.
+ Monitor work package readiness, including engineering deliverables, material availability, permits, equipment, and workforce requirements.
+ Facilitate workface planning activities to maximize labor productivity and minimize construction delays.
+ Ensure alignment between project schedules, work packaging strategies, and field execution requirements.
+ Track and report AWP performance metrics, constraints, productivity trends, and package completion status.
+ Identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks, interfaces, and execution risks impacting construction progress.
+ Support construction planning, look-ahead scheduling, and readiness reviews to ensure efficient work execution.
+ Promote AWP best practices and provide guidance to project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to improve project delivery performance.
To apply for this position, please send your most recent CV to Lamis.Hakami@trsstaffing.com
